---
title: "2026-05-11 SCEPTRE - Create Objects"
output: html_document
params:
  moi_level: "low"
  sample_list:
    - MOI1_1
  covariate_columns:
    - channel
  prefix: "MOI1_1"
---

```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(here)
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
})

if (!requireNamespace("sceptre", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'sceptre' is required. Install with renv::install('katsevich-lab/sceptre').")
}

get_dynamic_formula <- function(covariate_df, requested_covariates) {
  keep_covariates <- character(0)
  for (cov in requested_covariates) {
    if (cov %in% colnames(covariate_df) && 
        data.table::uniqueN(na.omit(covariate_df[[cov]])) > 1) {
      keep_covariates <- c(keep_covariates, cov)
    }
  }
  rhs_terms <- c(
    "log(response_n_nonzero)",
    "log(response_n_umis)",
    "log(grna_n_nonzero)",
    "log(grna_n_umis)",
    keep_covariates
  )
  stats::as.formula(paste("~", paste(rhs_terms, collapse = " + ")))
}

get_discovery_pairs <- function(table_s3) {
  required_cols <- c("cell_type", "intended_target_name_hg38", "gene_id")
  if (!all(required_cols %in% colnames(table_s3))) {
    stop("Table S3 is missing required columns.")
  }

  discovery_pairs <- unique(
    table_s3[
      cell_type == "WTC11" &
        !is.na(intended_target_name_hg38) & nzchar(intended_target_name_hg38) &
        !is.na(gene_id) & nzchar(gene_id),
      .(
        grna_target = intended_target_name_hg38,
        response_id = gene_id
      )
    ]
  )

  if (nrow(discovery_pairs) == 0) {
    stop("No discovery pairs found for WTC11 in Table S3.")
  }

  discovery_pairs
}

moi_level <- params$moi_level
samples_to_merge <- params$sample_list
prefix <- params$prefix

output_root <- here("results", "2026-06-10_SCEPTRE")
objects_dir <- file.path(output_root, "objects")
tables_dir <- file.path(output_root, "tables")

dir.create(objects_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Creating merged replicate SCEPTRE object for MOI level:", moi_level, "\n")
cat("Samples to merge:", paste(samples_to_merge, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## Create Discovery pairs

```{r}
discovery_pairs_path <- file.path(tables_dir, "discovery_pairs_wtc11_all.tsv")
table_s3_path <- here(
  "..",
  "results",
  "formatted_dc_tap_results",
  "Table_S3_Final_DC_TAP_Seq_Results_w_Chromatin_Categories_on_resized_and_merged_elements_250908_append.tsv"
)

table_s3 <- data.table::fread(table_s3_path)

# Build discovery pairs from all WTC11 target-gene pairs (no significance filtering)
discovery_pairs <- get_discovery_pairs(
  table_s3 = table_s3
)

fwrite(discovery_pairs, discovery_pairs_path, sep = "\t")
cat("\nWrote", nrow(discovery_pairs), "WTC11 discovery pairs to:", discovery_pairs_path, "\n")
```

## Load Seurat and Filter

```{r load-seurat}
cat("\nLoading Seurat object...\n")
seu_path <- here("results", "qc_experiment_June_2026", "combined_cdna_seurat_filtered.rds")
seu <- readRDS(seu_path)

cat("Original Seurat object:\n")
print(seu)

# Get cell names for samples of interest, then subset by cells
meta_df <- as.data.table(seu[[]], keep.rownames = "cell_id")
sample_cells <- meta_df[sample %in% samples_to_merge, cell_id]

if (length(sample_cells) == 0) {
  stop("No cells found for selected samples: ", paste(samples_to_merge, collapse = ", "))
}

cat("\nFiltering to samples:", paste(samples_to_merge, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Cells selected:", length(sample_cells), "\n")
seu_merged <- subset(seu, cells = sample_cells)

cat("Merged Seurat object:\n")
print(seu_merged)
cat("Sample column values:", paste(unique(seu_merged$sample), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## Create SCEPTRE Object from Merged Seurat

```{r create-sceptre-object}
cat("\nCreating SCEPTRE object from merged Seurat...\n")

# Get response genes and gRNA data from merged Seurat
response_matrix <- Seurat::GetAssayData(seu_merged, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
grna_matrix <- Seurat::GetAssayData(seu_merged, assay = "gRNA", layer = "counts")

# Build gRNA target mapping from Table S3 using hg38 target names
guide_target_map <- table_s3[
  !is.na(guide_ids) & nzchar(guide_ids) &
    !is.na(intended_target_name_hg38) & nzchar(intended_target_name_hg38),
  .(grna_id = gsub("_", "-", trimws(unlist(strsplit(guide_ids, ",", fixed = TRUE))), fixed = TRUE)),
  by = .(grna_target = intended_target_name_hg38)
]
guide_target_map <- unique(guide_target_map[nzchar(grna_id)])

guide_conflicts <- guide_target_map[, .(n_targets = data.table::uniqueN(grna_target)), by = grna_id]
guide_conflicts <- guide_conflicts[n_targets > 1]
if (nrow(guide_conflicts) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Some guides map to multiple intended_target_name_hg38 values, e.g.: ",
    paste(utils::head(guide_conflicts$grna_id, 10), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

grna_target_df <- data.table(grna_id = rownames(grna_matrix))
grna_target_df <- merge(grna_target_df, guide_target_map, by = "grna_id", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
grna_target_df$grna_target[is.na(grna_target_df$grna_target)] <- "non-targeting"
grna_target_df <- unique(grna_target_df[, .(grna_id, grna_target)])

# Keep only guides in discovery targets + non-targeting controls
discovery_pair_targets <- unique(discovery_pairs$grna_target)
valid_grna_ids <- grna_target_df[
  grna_target %in% discovery_pair_targets | grna_target == "non-targeting",
  grna_id
]
grna_matrix <- grna_matrix[valid_grna_ids, , drop = FALSE]
grna_target_df <- grna_target_df[grna_id %in% rownames(grna_matrix)]

# Keep a copy for downstream analyses
fwrite(grna_target_df, file.path(tables_dir, "grna_target_data_frame.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# Keep only cells with at least one observed guide
mask_any_guide <- Matrix::colSums(grna_matrix) > 0
response_matrix <- response_matrix[, mask_any_guide, drop = FALSE]
grna_matrix <- grna_matrix[, mask_any_guide, drop = FALSE]

# Extra covariates from metadata - ONLY requested covariates
meta_merged <- as.data.table(seu_merged[[]], keep.rownames = "cell_id")
cell_ids <- colnames(response_matrix)

# Select only the columns requested in covariate_columns parameter
requested_cols <- params$covariate_columns[params$covariate_columns %in% colnames(meta_merged)]
if (length(requested_cols) == 0) {
  covariate_df <- data.frame(row.names = cell_ids)
} else {
  covariate_df <- as.data.frame(meta_merged[match(cell_ids, cell_id), ..requested_cols], row.names = cell_ids)
}

# Keep only discovery pairs available in this merged object
valid_response_ids <- rownames(response_matrix)
valid_grna_targets <- unique(grna_target_df$grna_target)

# Restrict discovery pairs to readout genes from RNA feature metadata
rna_feature_meta <- as.data.table(seu_merged[["RNA"]][[]], keep.rownames = "feature_id")
if (!("is_readout_gene" %in% colnames(rna_feature_meta))) {
  stop("RNA feature metadata is missing is_readout_gene; cannot filter discovery pairs to readout genes.")
}
readout_response_ids <- unique(rna_feature_meta[is_readout_gene %in% TRUE, feature_id])

discovery_pairs <- unique(discovery_pairs[
  grna_target %in% valid_grna_targets &
    response_id %in% valid_response_ids &
    response_id %in% readout_response_ids,
  .(grna_target, response_id)
])

manual_discovery_pair_ids <- c(
  "PCBP1|chr2:70089449-70089750",
  "PRSS8|chr16:31130895-31131196",
  "SLC2A3|chr12:7995234-7995535",
  "PRSS8|chr16:31142244-31142545",
  "PCBP1|chr2:70142017-70142318",
  "FAM111A|chr11:59158502-59158803",
  "SH3BGRL3|chr1:26275563-26275864",
  "CEBPB|chr20:50192829-50193130",
  "NDUFB7|chr19:14574208-14574509",
  "TP53|chr17:7656987-7657288",
  "CDC37|chr19:10390714-10391015",
  "PIMREG|chr17:6455432-6455733",
  "EIF4A1|chr17:7560402-7560703",
  "SLC2A3|chr12:7960676-7960977",
  "SLC2A3|chr12:7907152-7907453",
  "SLC2A3|chr12:7916078-7916379",
  "SLC2A3|chr12:7933204-7933505",
  "SLC2A3|chr12:8018981-8019282",
  "TP53|chr17:7632481-7632782",
  "TP53|chr17:7632845-7633443",
  "TP53|chr17:7676578-7676879",
  "TP53|chr17:7707485-7707786",
  "RPL8|chr8:144805052-144805353",
  "CFL1|chr11:65818218-65818519",
  "HMGA1|chr6:34196258-34196559",
  "PCBP1|chr2:70086102-70086403",
  "IER2|chr19:13163708-13164141",
  "ENO2|chr12:6925491-6926215",
  "C12orf57|chr12:6962060-6962361",
  "PCBP1|chr2:70124973-70125470"
)
manual_discovery_pair_table <- unique(data.table(pair_id = manual_discovery_pair_ids))
manual_discovery_pair_table[, c("gene_symbol", "grna_target") := tstrsplit(pair_id, "|", fixed = TRUE)]

manual_pair_lookup <- unique(table_s3[
  cell_type == "WTC11",
  .(
    gene_symbol,
    grna_target = intended_target_name_hg38,
    response_id = gene_id
  )
])
manual_discovery_pairs <- merge(
  manual_discovery_pair_table,
  manual_pair_lookup,
  by = c("gene_symbol", "grna_target"),
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

missing_manual_pairs <- manual_discovery_pairs[is.na(response_id), pair_id]
if (length(missing_manual_pairs) > 0) {
  stop("Manual discovery pairs missing from Table S3: ", paste(missing_manual_pairs, collapse = ", "))
}

ambiguous_manual_pairs <- manual_discovery_pairs[
  ,
  .(n_response_ids = data.table::uniqueN(response_id)),
  by = .(pair_id)
][n_response_ids > 1, pair_id]
if (length(ambiguous_manual_pairs) > 0) {
  stop("Manual discovery pairs map to multiple response IDs: ", paste(ambiguous_manual_pairs, collapse = ", "))
}

unavailable_manual_pairs <- manual_discovery_pairs[
  !(grna_target %in% valid_grna_targets & response_id %in% valid_response_ids),
  pair_id
]
if (length(unavailable_manual_pairs) > 0) {
  stop("Manual discovery pairs unavailable in merged object: ", paste(unavailable_manual_pairs, collapse = ", "))
}

discovery_pairs_before_manual <- nrow(discovery_pairs)
manual_discovery_pairs <- unique(manual_discovery_pairs[, .(grna_target, response_id)])
discovery_pairs <- unique(rbindlist(
  list(discovery_pairs, manual_discovery_pairs),
  use.names = TRUE
))

cat("Manual discovery pairs requested:", length(manual_discovery_pair_ids), "\n")
cat("Manual discovery pairs available:", nrow(manual_discovery_pairs), "\n")
cat(
  "Manual discovery pairs added after duplicate removal:",
  nrow(discovery_pairs) - discovery_pairs_before_manual,
  "\n"
)

cat("Discovery pairs available in merged object:", nrow(discovery_pairs), "\n")

if (nrow(discovery_pairs) == 0) {
  stop("No discovery pairs remained after filtering for merged object.")
}

cat("Response matrix:", nrow(response_matrix), "x", ncol(response_matrix), "\n")
cat("gRNA matrix:", nrow(grna_matrix), "x", ncol(grna_matrix), "\n")
cat("Covariate data frame:", nrow(covariate_df), "x", ncol(covariate_df), "\n")
cat("Discovery pairs:", nrow(discovery_pairs), "\n")

# Create formula with requested covariates
formula_object <- get_dynamic_formula(covariate_df, params$covariate_columns)

# Create SCEPTRE object
sceptre_object_merged <- sceptre::import_data(
  response_matrix = response_matrix,
  grna_matrix = grna_matrix,
  grna_target_data_frame = as.data.frame(grna_target_df),
  moi = moi_level,
  extra_covariates = covariate_df
)

sceptre_object_merged <- sceptre::set_analysis_parameters(
  sceptre_object = sceptre_object_merged,
  discovery_pairs = discovery_pairs,
  side = "both",
  formula_object = formula_object
)

print(sceptre_object_merged)
```

## Save Object

```{r save-object}
cat("\nSaving merged SCEPTRE object...\n")

object_name <- paste0(prefix,"_sceptre_object_", moi_level, "_moi_merged")
object_path <- file.path(objects_dir, paste0(object_name, ".rds"))

saveRDS(sceptre_object_merged, object_path)
cat("Saved:", object_path, "\n")
cat("File size:", format(file.size(object_path), units = "auto"), "\n")
```

## Summary

```{r summary}
summary_dt <- data.table(
  object_name = object_name,
  moi_level = moi_level,
  samples = paste(samples_to_merge, collapse = " + "),
  n_cells = ncol(response_matrix),
  n_response_genes = nrow(response_matrix),
  n_grnas = nrow(grna_matrix),
  n_covariates = ncol(covariate_df),
  n_discovery_pairs = nrow(discovery_pairs)
)

data.table::fwrite(summary_dt, file.path(tables_dir, paste0(prefix, "_sceptre_object_", moi_level, "_summary.tsv")), sep = "\t")

cat("\n=== MERGED OBJECT SUMMARY ===\n")
print(summary_dt)
```
